stages.mythic: Edit the previous stage into a far larger and richer training ground, as if a great deal more money and labour had been spent. Keep its three targets on stands, the barrel, the rope and stone trainer and the long lane. Replace the plain shed by a grand three-storey gallery of dark oak on a high base of fine dressed pale stone with a wide stone stair, arched stone openings, tiled roofs with two wings stretching along the lane, racks of great bows and sheaves of arrows on every level, iron braziers on the corners. At the far left end of the lane rises a colossal lashed timber frame four houses high, far taller than the gallery, stacking three giant round targets of woven straw and dark oak one above the other, with one arrow as long as a ship's mast in the centre of the top target. Around each giant target hovers a thin ring of pale ice-blue crystal, and long curling ribbons of pale blue air sweep down the lane toward them. The wood and stone stay intact and brown and grey.
